title: Graphite Implementation Campaign

baseline.authority: Latest native build supplied in this workspace; no claim about unseen newer work elsewhere

observations.finding: MANIFEST.json and workbench/version.py identify the supplied native build as Graphite 0.1.0. The manifest lists 1,101 payload entries. This planning step did not rerun the release verification.

The source contains the Kernel dispatcher, typed artifacts, condition tracking, investigations, document editing, working copies, resident-service controls, a Tool Atlas, and a staC chain builder. Their presence is source evidence, not a claim of complete new-spec behavior.
shell2.py constructs PathBar and explicitly hides it. The old head uses the wordmark, eight menus, monitors, and a System symbol. The borderless active-path design has not landed in this build.

context_menu.py already has Target, Entry, finders, providers, revision-aware document actions, and nested menus. Router currently suppresses another context menu inside ContextMenu; Programs rows and dropdown commands need deliberate extension.

brain_runtime.py describes a pinned CPU worker. local_brain.py reports backend CPU, launches with -ngl 0, and disables several cache facilities. Vulkan and the traffic cop are implementation work, not already enabled acceleration.

agent_profiles.py registers narrow built-in assignment profiles. helpers.py describes shipped module helpers and a future sandboxed-Python source kind. A general computer operator and the full self-improvement cycle are not established by those foundations.

latest_owner_decisions: The head shows the full active workspace path as directly editable text, without a surrounding box.
Programs entries and dropdown menu commands participate in contextual cascading actions, alongside work objects.
Use twenty substantial implementation passes for the entire master specification.
No automatic test run after each pass; batch related work and use a quick launch-and-use check. Extra testing requires a concrete failure or data-integrity concern. No new test suites by default.

Prefer useful supported GPU inference while CPU preparation remains responsive. Keep priority, queue ordering, CPU niceness, and actual preemption limits distinct. Adapt resource containment to GPU virtual-address behavior.

passes.implementation_note: Advisory shared-memory admission in existing owned queued workers, foreground leases, one inference lane, bounded CPU slots, background nice/thread hints, separate owner queue priority and real readback. Linux CPU and Vulkan worker memory guards retain Stop and explicit recovery.

completion_policy: A pass closes on delivered usable implementation and the relevant observed boundary, not a plan, screenshot, test count, or model assertion. Record live-model, native-application, account, and owner-host qualification separately. P20 owner-host acceptance remains open without the actual machine.
verification_policy: No automatic tests per pass. Batch related changes and perform one quick launch-and-use check. Skip new tests for cosmetic changes. Reuse a small existing check only when an actual failure or specific data-integrity concern warrants it. No routine full suites, all-case reruns, model sweeps, or assertion-count targets.
